使用火箭主动攻击时，每命中<color=#F74848>1</color>名目标，获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4010500>[情报]</buf>，可叠加，最多<color=#F74848>25</color>层；火箭的负重降低<color=#F74848>130</color>；

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

401002.name: 知己知彼
401002.SpecificEffects: 行动开始时，若<buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>层数小于等于<color=#F74848>10</color>层，则不会减少

401003.name: 运筹
401003.describe: 使火箭的弹数完全回复，并获得<color=#F74848>2</color>层<buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>，然后可使用剩余移动力继续行动

401004.name: 战术指挥
401004.describe: 选择<color=#F74848>1</color>个技能进行释放。使用后切换为<skill activeSkill=4010041>[强攻战术]</skill>、<skill activeSkill=4010042>[机动战术]</skill>、<skill activeSkill=4010043>[总攻战术]</skill>

401005.name: 增益弹头
401005.SpecificEffects: 使用火箭攻击时，战后对打击范围内的友军施加<color=#F74848>1</color>个随机增益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

401006.name: 广域轰炸
401006.describe: 消耗<color=#F74848>2</color>发弹药，使用火箭攻击所选<range type=1>5×5格</range>范围内的所有目标，对每个部位造成<color=#F74848>0.25</color>倍范围伤害，战后使全体友军获得<color=#F74848>1</color>个随机增益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

401007.name: 情报优势
401007.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>大于等于<color=#F74848>20</color>层时，友军遭受主动范围攻击时遭受伤害降低<color=#F74848>15%</color>，战后获得<color=#F74848>1</color>个随机增益效果，持续<color=#F74848>2</color>回合

401008.name: 掠阵轰炸
401008.describe: 同时使用两门火箭攻击所选<range type=1>5×5格</range>范围内的所有目标，对每个部位造成<color=#F74848>2×0.15</color>倍范围伤害，每命中<color=#F74848>1</color>名目标，战后使全体友军获得<color=#F74848>1</color>层<buf ID=4010082>[奇袭战术]</buf>，可叠加<color=#F74848>5</color>层，单次攻击最多获得<color=#F74848>5</color>层

400031.name: Indiscriminate 1
400031.SpecificEffects: After the first attack with a Tactical Weapon each turn, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, with Final DMG <color=#F74848>-30%</color>, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.

400033.name: Strategic Bombing 4
400033.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf> is complete, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

400034.name: Indiscriminate 2
400034.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Tactical Weapon for the first time each turn, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> AP cost, DMG <color=#F74848>+4%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

400035.name: Indiscriminate 3
400035.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> is triggered, allow continued moving with the remaining movement.

400036.name: Indiscriminate 4
400036.SpecificEffects: After triggering <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf>, it no longer reduces final damage.

401041.name: 算无遗策1
401041.SpecificEffects: 出击时额外获得<color=#F74848>5</color>层<buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>

400043.name: Power Innovation 3
400043.SpecificEffects: When destroying a target, additionally restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

401044.name: 算无遗策2
401044.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>效果提升至使所有友军伤害提升<color=#F74848>1.2%</color>，行动开始时移除<color=#F74848>2</color>层

401046.name: 算无遗策4
401046.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>的上限提升至<color=#F74848>35</color>层，且<buf ID=900123>[情报]</buf>对自身效果提升<color=#F74848>75%</color>
